description.zh: 点击飞盘揭晓小伙伴，通过 5 题加减法测试后带它登上月球；答对不足则重新来过。K1/K2 两个等级只改变算式的数字范围，玩法本身不变。
description.en: Tap the UFO to reveal a character, pass a 5-question add/subtract test to land it on the moon; falling short sends you back to retry. K1/K2 only change the arithmetic's number range — the mechanic itself never changes.

designModel.zh: 单一难度轴模型：K1/K2 之间没有新机制、没有新场景，只有 data.js 的 GRADE_CONFIG.max 从 5 变成 10。这是 Clio 系列里最小的等级阶梯——比 MindSeeds 的 difference-scout（5 轴）小得多，先把「叙事驱动小游戏 + 雷达上报」的骨架立起来。
designModel.en: Single-axis design: K1 and K2 add no new mechanic and no new scene — only data.js's GRADE_CONFIG.max moves from 5 to 10. This is the smallest grade ladder in the Clio series, deliberately smaller than MindSeeds's difference-scout (5 axes) — this module exists to stand up the 'narrative game + radar reporting' skeleton first.

ageRange.noteZh: 对应幼儿园 K1/K2 两个年龄段，与 data.js 的 GRADE_CONFIG 键一一对应。
ageRange.noteEn: Maps to kindergarten grades K1/K2, matching data.js's GRADE_CONFIG keys one-to-one.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: Clio 是叙事驱动的沉浸式小游戏工坊：一次完整会话围绕一个故事（飞盘登月）展开，答题只是故事里的一道关卡，节奏比 MindSeeds 的高频快循环训练慢，也不像 Learning 系列那样显式讲解概念。飞盘登月不教「什么是加减法」，只提供一个有情境的练习场——概念讲解仍属于 Learning 系列的职责。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: Clio is the narrative-driven, immersive game workshop series: one full session is wrapped in a story (landing a UFO on the moon), and the quiz is just one obstacle inside that story — paced slower than MindSeeds's high-frequency drill loops, and unlike the Learning series it never explicitly teaches a concept. UFO Moon Adventure does not teach what addition or subtraction is; it only supplies a themed practice ground — explicit concept instruction stays the Learning series's job.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次完整的 5 题测试结束（无论通过还是失败）都会上报 RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC 一次，不按题目粒度上报——飞盘登月是批量测验，不是逐题打点。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every finished 5-question run (pass or fail) reports RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC exactly once — UFO Moon Adventure reports per batch run, not per question.

rootGeneScopeNote.zh: 这是仓库里第一个真实运行并上报 RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC 的模块，让 NUMBER_SENSE 这一支雷达辐条第一次拿到真数据。
rootGeneScopeNote.en: This is the first module in the repo that actually runs and reports RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC, giving the NUMBER_SENSE radar spoke its first real data.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 唯一的难度轴。K1 的加减法运算数不超过 5，K2 不超过 10；镜像 data.js 的 GRADE_CONFIG 与 game.js 的 difficultyAxisFor()。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: The only difficulty axis. K1 keeps every operand/result within 5, K2 within 10; mirrors data.js's GRADE_CONFIG and game.js's difficultyAxisFor().

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次会话固定 5 题（data.js 的 TOTAL_QUESTIONS），答对 3 题及以上（PASS_THRESHOLD）视为通过，对应 0.6 的通过率。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: One session is always 5 questions (data.js's TOTAL_QUESTIONS); 3 or more correct (PASS_THRESHOLD) counts as a pass, i.e. a 0.6 pass ratio.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在 5 以内完成加减法测试，答对 3 题以上登月成功。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Pass a within-5 add/subtract test — 3 or more correct lands the UFO on the moon.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在 10 以内完成加减法测试，答对 3 题以上登月成功。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Pass a within-10 add/subtract test — 3 or more correct lands the UFO on the moon.
